app.name: Macrofill
app.blocked: Macrofill is open in another tab with an older version. Close that tab to go on.

login.title: Log in
login.failed: Couldn't log in. Check the connection and try again.

home.userUnknown: Couldn't check who's logged in, so a meal can't be started yet. Check the connection and try again.

step.noProducts: No products for this ingredient yet.
step.discardQuestion: Discard this meal? What you entered so far is lost.
step.discardFailed: Couldn't discard the meal on this device. Try again.
step.otherClass: {{product}} is a {{class}} product. It is used for this step, and from now on it appears under {{class}}.

scale.connectHint: Turn the scale on and set it to grams, then connect. The list shows all nearby devices: pick the scale.
scale.connectFailed: Couldn't connect to the scale. Try again.
scale.placeBowl: Put the empty bowl or plate on the scale, wait until the weight settles, then tap Start.
scale.wrongUnit: The scale isn't showing grams. Switch it to grams to go on.
scale.waiting: Waiting for the weight to settle…
scale.unstable: The weight didn't settle. Use {{grams}} g?
scale.negative: The amount is below zero, for example after a tare. Enter the grams by hand, read the scale again, or undo.
scale.correctionNeedsStable: Hold still: the grams can be used once the weight settles.
scale.reconnectingHint: The scale disconnected. The meal goes on once it's back. If it switched itself off: take the bowl off, turn the scale on, then put the bowl back.
scale.finishByHand: Enter the remaining weights by hand
scale.dropped: The scale disconnected. Enter the remaining weights by hand.
scale.smallAmounts: The scale can miss a few grams added slowly: add small, calorie-dense items in one go, or enter them by hand.

summary.title: Summary
summary.saveFailed: Couldn't save the meal. Check the connection and try again.

saved.title: Meal saved
saved.pending: It's kept on this device and sent to your account as soon as there's a connection.
saved.refused: The server refused this meal. It's kept on this device and listed in Today under "Couldn't be saved".

today.title: Today
today.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the meal. Try again.
today.refusedHint: The server refused these meals, so they're not in your day. Remove them, and log them again if you need to.

product.title: Add a product
product.intro: Type the values from the label, per 100 g. Leave a value empty if the label doesn't list it.
product.name: Name

problem.name: Enter the product name.
problem.tooLarge: Can't be more than 100 g per 100 g.
problem.total: Carbs, protein, fat, fibre and salt add up to more than 100 g per 100 g. Check the values.

product.kcalWarning: The energy ({{kcal}} kcal) doesn't match the macros, which add up to about {{expected}} kcal. Check the values.
product.offline: Adding a product needs a connection. Connect, then try again.
product.failed: Couldn't save the product. Check the connection and try again.
product.refused: The server refused this product. Check the values.
product.barcodeTaken: Another product already has this barcode. Close this form and scan again to use it.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Point the camera at the barcode on the package.
scan.unsupported: This browser can't scan barcodes. Type the digits instead.
scan.denied: The camera isn't allowed for Macrofill. Type the digits instead, or allow the camera in the browser's site settings.
scan.unavailable: The camera can't be opened. Type the digits instead.

problem.format: A barcode has 8, 12 or 13 digits. Check what you typed.
problem.checkDigit: The last digit doesn't match the others. Check the digits.

scan.lookupFailed: Couldn't look the product up. Check the connection and try again.
